steps.text: Hello! I am your AI Guide. I will guide you through each step of the experiment. Please follow the instructions carefully and perform the actions as directed. Before we begin, let us familiarize ourselves with the simulation interface. To start, click on the Start Walkthrough.

The simulation walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment. First measure the Thevenin resistance and Thevenin voltage. The load resistance slider will unlock after the Thevenin voltage is recorded.

Now, you may either click the Auto Connect button to make the circuit connections automatically or connect the circuit manually by following the highlighted terminals. Let's begin with the first connection.
steps.audio: /audios/Now, you may either click the Auto Connect button.wav

steps.text: To measure the Thevenin resistance.
Connect the multimeter by click and drag the wire from terminal 5 and drop it on terminal 11.
steps.audio: /audios/Connect the multimeter by click and drag the wire from terminal 5 and drop it on terminal 11.wav

steps.text: Similarly, connect terminal 6 to terminal 13.
Now, short circuit terminals 9 to 10.
Case 1 connections are completed. Click on the Check button to verify the connections.
This connection is wrong.

Autoconnect completed. The digital multimeter is now displaying the Thevenin equivalent resistance value. Now, click on the add button to add the reading to the observation table.
Please set RL using the resistance slider.

steps.text: Please make the required connections as per the given instructions.
Connections Verified successfully. The digital multimeter is now displaying the Thevenin resistance value. Now, click on the add button to add the reading to the observation table.
Reading is added to the observation table. Now remove the connections 9 to 10, 5 to 11 and 6 to 13.
Now measure the Thevenin voltage by connecting the power supply terminals and voltmeter to the circuit.
Connect terminal 7 to 9.
Connect terminal 8 to 10.
Connect the voltmeter 1 to 11.
Connect terminal 2 to terminal 13.
Click on the Check button to verify the connections.
steps.audio: /audios/Before clicking the Check button for Case 2 and Case 3 connections.wav

steps.text: Connections Verified successfully. Now switch ON the power supply and set the required voltage value.
The reading is displayed on the voltmeter. Now, click on the add button to add the reading to the observation table.
The Thevenin voltage is added to the observation table and the load resistance slider is now unlocked at zero ohms. Turn OFF the power supply and remove the voltmeter connections 1 to 11 and 2 to 13.
steps.audio: /audios/After reading is added for the second case.wav

steps.text: Now measure the load current.
Connect the ammeter terminals 3 to 11.
Connect terminal 4 to 12.
Connect terminal 13 to 14.
Click on the Check button to verify the connections.
The reading is displayed on the ammeter. Click Add at zero ohms, then move the load resistance slider one division at a time and click Add for every resistance value.
steps.audio: /audios/Power supply turned ON for the 3rd case.wav

steps.text: The final reading is added to the observation table. Now, click on the Calculate button to theoretically verify the theorem.
steps.audio: /audios/After reading is added for the third case.wav

steps.text: The resistance and source values are displayed in the theoretical verification panel. Enter the calculated values in the input field, and click the Verify button to verify the theorem.
